cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll organize the project report. My printer troubleshooting ranks above your restart suggestion.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got every invoice printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Implementation second, identifying the blockage first. You write your section in your own words; I'll keep the overall order clear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was the blockage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stress testing goes above troubleshooting. Put my menu under that heading and yours under successful recovery. You can present the results; I'll follow your wording, with the categories in that order.
